item.title: Norse Atlantic flags bankruptcy risk as flights suspended
item.description: Norwegian airline Norse Atlantic has suspended flights and intends to file for bankruptcy if a short-term financing solution is not secured urgently, becoming the latest casualty of the sector-wide turmoil provoked by the Iran war.

item.title: Around 40 jobs to go as HSI set to be liquidated
item.description: Horse Sport Ireland, the country's governing body for equestrian sport, is set to be liquidated, with the loss of around 40 jobs.

item.title: Almost half of shoppers have encountered scams - survey
item.description: Almost half of Irish shoppers say they have encountered a suspected online shopping scam in the past year, while one in eight reported losing money on an online purchase, new research from Banking & Payments Federation Ireland suggests.

item.title: Why we fall for Black Friday scams - and what we can do about it
item.description: Consumers are caught by scams which use urgency triggers, confirmation bias and trust signals to create a false sense of security and scarcity

item.title: What really happens to your data when you click 'delete'?
item.description: The process of deletion is often poorly explained by tech providers and there's a lack of transparency around how such requests are processed
